title: Nutty Crisp Mediterranean Lamb Kebabs
description: A briny, crisp, and cozy Mediterranean dish featuring black treacle and rest-meat, made with ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat
In a large bowl, whisk together black treacle, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper
Add the lamb pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade
Thread the lamb pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees
While the kebabs are cooking, toast the pine nuts in a small skillet over medium heat
Once the kebabs are done, brush with toasted pine nuts and sprinkle with chopped parsley
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired
